name: Threads-TS-TW
title: Threads
description: Forty hair-thin white lines weave into a ribbon that ripples across a black stage. Each strand drifts on its own, so the band swells into a crest and dips like cloth in wind.
use: A dark, minimal hero needs one delicate moving line to break the emptiness.
avoid: The band is thin and dim, so it vanishes behind busy content or on light pages.
a11y: A canvas backdrop with no labels; its constant drift ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage carries a band of very fine white threads woven into a shallow wave. The bundle is dense on the right and thins into a single bright line on the left.
behaves: The ribbon of threads ripples and rolls sideways, strands drifting at different rates so the band rises into a crest and settles again. The pointer bends the wave where it moves.
customise: Colour, amplitude, strand spacing and pointer response are props; strand count and line widths are fixed in the shader.
weight: heavy: A fullscreen shader loops over 40 lines for every pixel on every frame.
demo: White threads at amplitude 1 on a black panel with pointer interaction on.
polishWhy: Delicate threads with a smooth wave; the band is faint and fills only a thin strip.
